loss_saturation_basin.description: Registry of stable basins where information loss saturates under recursive continuation.

basins.name: dissipative_transport_basin
basins.condition: Stable fixed-point reached; aggregate flux is invariant under further iteration.

basins.name: admissibility_manifold_basin
basins.condition: State remains within the interior of the admissibility window (epsilon > epsilon_threshold).

basins.name: branch_pruning_equilibrium
basins.condition: Rate of branch generation equals rate of pruning (OMR-001).
